_about: Retrofit translation (skills/retrofit-project, 2026-10-15) of tools/gate/gate.json into the framework's generic schema (tools/gate/gate.schema.md at the pinned tag). DOCUMENTATION ONLY -- this file is NOT wired to anything yet. The actually-enforcing gate stays tools/gate/po_gate.py reading tools/gate/gate.json, untouched. Moving enforcement onto tools/gate/gate.py is a separate, later decision (framework-map.md calls it a later, separate step after F2).
_fields_needing_a_decision_before_this_c: vendors.*.names is empty on purpose: this project's signatures are 100% legacy format ('<Name> . <job>:', e.g. 'Codex . PR review:'), never the new format ('<Role> . <Vendor>:') this field is for. Recognition is carried entirely by legacy_signers below. If PO Reader ever adopts new-format signatures, names needs real values and legacy_signers can shrink.

magic and secrets were left at schema default (not copied from anywhere, because tools/gate/po_gate.py's own built-in defaults were never compared line-by-line against the generic gate.py's defaults). Before this file could ever go live, diff the two default lists; a silent mismatch here would change what the scan step catches.

verdict_sha_min_length is set to 7, not the schema's own default of 40, per the Framework Orchestrator's own F2 note (agent-orchestration docs/framework-map.md row 55: 'PO Reader needs 7, not the new default 40') -- carried forward here, not re-derived by me.
